# D-32 field register

Part of [D-32](D-32-shell-navigation.md). One row per field the milestone pane or board shows, with what the redesign does with it and why.

**Rule: nothing is removed from import, storage or export.** "Hidden by default" and "Omit" are display choices only. Every alias in `INGEST_CONFIG.headerAliases` stays. "New, derived" means the value is computed from data the app already holds unless the last column names a build item.

| Field | Source | Shown today | In redesign | Where | Why | Backend and import |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Activity ID | Import: activity id, act id, id, task id, activity code, task code. Missing ID becomes ROW-n | Card header, #ID label, tooltip, grids | **Keep** | Pane header in mono. Read only. | Key for every annotation (msKeyFor). Never editable. | None |
| Activity name | Import: activity name, name, task name, description | Card title, row name, tooltip | **Keep** | Pane title. Editable as an override, with the edited dot. | Unchanged behaviour. | None |
| Display label (short title) | User. Defaults to the name cut to 22 characters | More fields; marker label by SHORT_TITLE_MODE | **Shown differently** | Shown on the board as the marker label. Edited under More fields. | Round 1 called these "remark stickers". They are the short title, so the Display toggle is renamed. | None |
| Mark and type | Derived (classifyType, markerFor). User override | Card icon menu | **Keep** | Type button at the top of the pane. | Unchanged. | None |
| Band · Type line | Derived (task.disc, TYPE_LABELS) | Card subline | **Keep** | Kept under the title. | Tells the user where the row sits without scrolling. | None |
| Health | Computed (stateFor: actual, float thresholds). User override MS_HEALTH_OVERRIDE (5 dots) | Card pill and popover, marker, row dot | **Shown differently** | Pill with the 5 dots, plus "set by you" when overridden and "from schedule" when the schedule says complete. | Round 1 showed a dropdown, which hid the override. Users need to know who set the status. | None |
| Complete vs Done | Complete: finish actual from P6. Done: user override (DONEUSER) | Labels, marker colour | **Shown differently** | Both kept. Complete is black, Done is green, and the pill says who set it. | They mean different things and were easy to confuse. | None |
| WBS / Area | Derived band (task.disc or phase) | Card | **Keep** | First cell of the people block. Read only. | Not the same as the P78 Discipline field. | None |
| Discipline, Supervisor, Engineer (P78) | Import (optional aliases) or user | Card people block, grids | **Keep** | People block in the pane. Not on the board. | Useful for ownership. Too wide for the board. | None. Note: board CSV export lacks them (Build B19). |
| Start and Started | Import: start, early start, actual start. A suffix = actual | Card with Started / Not started | **Keep** | Dates row, with A badge when actual. | Unchanged. | None |
| Duration | Derived: finish minus start, calendar days | Card | **Shown differently** | Small text under Start. | Derived and rarely decided on; does not need its own box. | None |
| Finish | Import: finish, early finish, actual finish. A suffix = actual | Card, marker position | **Keep** | Dates row with A or Planned badge. | The only finish date the app holds. | None |
| Forecast date, Variance (round 1) | None | Not in the app | **Omit** | Removed from the mockup. | Round 1 invented them. Replaced by Finish and the derived movement rows below. | None |
| Total float | Import: total float, float, tf, total slack, free float | Card (read only since P72), tooltip, state thresholds | **Keep** | Dates row with a lock. Adjusted value when the finish was moved, as today. | Drives Critical and At risk. Risk flagged: free float is accepted as an alias for total float and can understate criticality [CONFIRM keep alias]. | None |
| Baseline finish and movement | BASELINE_MILESTONES matched by ID. Movement = finish minus baseline finish | Ghost marker tooltip only | **New, derived** | Row in the pane under the dates, when the baseline is shown. | The data is already held. Showing it where the user edits saves a hover. | None (derived, not stored) |
| Previous update finish and movement | Needs a retained previous upload | Not available | **New, derived** | Row in the pane when Compare is on. | Answers "what moved since last period" in place. | Needs Build B6, B7 |
| Progress % | Import: % complete variants. Override MS_PROGRESS_OVERRIDE | Card bar and word | **Keep** | Bar, value and word, as the card does. | Round 1 showed a dropdown. Restored. | None |
| MS weight | Derived equal split. User override | More fields | **Hidden by default** | Under More fields. | Only used for the progress rollup. | None |
| MS hours, Earned hours | Derived | More fields, tooltip | **Hidden by default** | Under More fields. | Supporting numbers, not decisions. | None |
| New update and Follow-up | User. Becomes an ENTRY (addEntry) | Card | **Keep** | In the Details tab, with Open / Sent / Done. | Writing the update is the main task each period. | None |
| Update history | ENTRIES | Card | **Move** | Updates tab in the pane. | Long lists push the editable fields off screen. | None |
| Predecessors and successors | Import: predecessor and successor details | Card chips | **Move** | Links tab in the pane. | Same reason. | None |
| P6 Status column | Import: activity status, status, state. Diagnostics only | Not shown | **Omit** | Still not shown. | Computed state covers it, and P6 status can disagree with the actual flag. Kept in import for diagnostics. | None |
| Optional row columns | Ref, Hrs, Alloc, %Prog, Type, Doc No., Task Code, Source IDs, Source Sched | View controls, Fields | **Move** | Display, Columns tab. Off by default as today. | One home for board display settings. | None |
| Report date | User. Import step 4 only (REPORT_META.reportDate) | Info bar | **Move** | Report button in the top bar. | Users change it each period. It should not need an import. | Needs Build B5 |
| Data date per schedule | Import step 4, per upload | Source chips in the info bar | **Shown differently** | Shown against each schedule in the period control. | Ties each set of markers to the date it reflects. | None |
